about: DataChat Agent evaluation set: 100 questions. sql = the correct query (rows must match); tables = tables the answer needs (schema recall); expect = facts the answer must contain (a list inside means any one of them); cite = acceptable [file, page] sources; kind unanswerable = the right answer is I don't know.

questions.question: How many buyers do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM buyers

questions.question: List the buyers based in Germany.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM buyers WHERE country = 'Germany'

questions.question: Which buyer has the longest payment terms?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM buyers ORDER BY payment_terms_days DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many suppliers are in Ludhiana?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suppliers WHERE city = 'Ludhiana'

questions.question: List all our fabric suppliers.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE category = 'Fabric'

questions.question: How many materials are measured in KG?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM materials WHERE unit = 'KG'

questions.question: Which supplier supplies Reactive Dyeing?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name FROM materials m JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = m.supplier_id WHERE m.name = 'Reactive Dyeing'

questions.question: How many styles are there for the SS26 season?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM styles WHERE season = 'SS26'

questions.question: What is the total order quantity of all styles for Northwind Apparel?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(s.order_qty) FROM styles s JOIN buyers b ON b.id = s.buyer_id WHERE b.name = 'Northwind Apparel'

questions.question: Which style has the highest FOB price?
questions.sql: SELECT style_no FROM styles ORDER BY fob_price_usd DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many styles does each season have?
questions.sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM styles GROUP BY season

questions.question: How many styles does each buyer have?
questions.sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(s.id) FROM buyers b JOIN styles s ON s.buyer_id = b.id GROUP BY b.name

questions.question: How many purchase orders have the status Open?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE status = 'Open'

questions.question: How many open POs do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE status IN ('Open', 'Partially Received')

questions.question: What is the total value of all purchase order lines?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM purchase_order_lines

questions.question: What is the total purchase order value for each supplier?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(l.amount) FROM purchase_order_lines l JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name

questions.question: Which supplier has the highest total purchase order value?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name FROM purchase_order_lines l JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many purchase orders were cancelled?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

questions.question: How many purchase orders are there in each status?
questions.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders GROUP BY status

questions.question: Which material has the highest total purchased quantity?
questions.sql: SELECT m.name FROM purchase_order_lines l JOIN materials m ON m.id = l.material_id GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY SUM(l.qty) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the highest rate we have paid for Cotton S/J 160 GSM in purchase orders?
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(l.rate) FROM purchase_order_lines l JOIN materials m ON m.id = l.material_id WHERE m.name = 'Cotton S/J 160 GSM'

questions.question: How many purchase orders were raised in May 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE po_date >= '2026-05-01' AND po_date < '2026-06-01'

questions.question: How many purchase orders were raised in each month?
questions.sql: SELECT to_char(po_date, 'YYYY-MM'), COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many production orders are delayed?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_orders WHERE status = 'Delayed'

questions.question: List the late orders with their style numbers.
questions.sql: SELECT s.style_no FROM production_orders p JOIN styles s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE p.status = 'Delayed'

questions.question: How many pieces in total are behind schedule on delayed production orders?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(planned_qty - produced_qty) FROM production_orders WHERE status = 'Delayed'

questions.question: How many production orders are on each production line?
questions.sql: SELECT line_no, COUNT(*) FROM production_orders GROUP BY line_no

questions.question: How many delayed production orders does each buyer have?
questions.sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM production_orders p JOIN styles s ON s.id = p.style_id JOIN buyers b ON b.id = s.buyer_id WHERE p.status = 'Delayed' GROUP BY b.name

questions.question: How many employees work in the Quality department?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Quality'

questions.question: How many employees are in each department?
questions.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department

questions.question: Who are our line supervisors?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE designation = 'Line Supervisor'

questions.question: How many employees joined in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE joined_on >= '2025-01-01' AND joined_on < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: Which employees work on line 3?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE line_no = 3

questions.question: Which styles have no production orders?
questions.sql: SELECT s.style_no FROM styles s LEFT JOIN production_orders p ON p.style_id = s.id WHERE p.id IS NULL

questions.question: How many different styles appear on purchase order lines?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT style_id) FROM purchase_order_lines

questions.question: What is the planned quantity of all In Progress production orders?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(planned_qty) FROM production_orders WHERE status = 'In Progress'

questions.question: Which buyers are from the United States or Canada?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM buyers WHERE country IN ('United States', 'Canada')

questions.question: What is the average salary of the operators?
What is the weather in Tiruppur today?
Which customers complained about late delivery last month?
How many artists are there?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist

questions.question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock'

questions.question: Which artist has the most albums?
questions.sql: SELECT ar.name FROM artist ar JOIN album al ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id GROUP BY ar.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the total sales per billing country?
questions.sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country

questions.question: What were the total sales in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date), SUM(total) FROM invoice GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Which customer has spent the most money in total?
questions.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'

questions.question: How many customers does each support employee look after?
questions.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM customer c JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

questions.question: What is the name of the longest track?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
questions.sql: SELECT m.name, COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN media_type m ON m.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY m.name

questions.question: How many tracks are in the playlist called Grunge?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_track pt JOIN playlist p ON p.playlist_id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.name = 'Grunge'

questions.question: List the albums by AC/DC.
questions.sql: SELECT al.title FROM album al JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'AC/DC'

questions.question: How many invoices were billed to the USA?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE billing_country = 'USA'

questions.question: Which genre has sold the most tracks?
questions.sql: SELECT g.name FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track WHERE composer IS NULL

questions.question: How many customers have a company listed?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE company IS NOT NULL

questions.question: What is the largest single invoice total?
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(total) FROM invoice

questions.question: Which employees report to the General Manager?
questions.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON m.employee_id = e.reports_to WHERE m.title = 'General Manager'
